title: Relative Bit of a Literal
statement: Let $T$ be a DNF term on $n$ variables, let $x$ be a binary assignment to those variables, and let $j$ be a position in the literal list of $T$. The relative bit at $j$ is the sum modulo $2$ of the bit of $x$ at that literal’s variable and the bit encoding the sign required by the literal.
hypotheses_covered: A binary assignment to the $n$ variables
A position $j$ in the term’s literal list
